name: Lamb
role: Partner in Lamb & Holland, Boston cattlemen
bio: Lamb, of the Boston firm Lamb & Holland, bought Billy Paddock's ranch down the river in March 1885 to stock with cattle.
mentions: Messrs. Lamb & Holland of Boston, have bought Billy Paddock's ranch down the river and will immediately begin buying cattle with which to stock it. We are more than pleased to welcom…

By the sale of Billy Paddock's ranch to [B. S.?] Lamb and with the stocking of this range the Little Missouri river front will be pretty well occupied for fifty miles up the river and fifty miles down. To our mind, however,…
Messrs. Hoer and Lamb of Mankato Minn. are here on a visit this week. They are stoping at Mark Wadsworth's, manager of the Bad Lands Cattle Co.
